premises.text: Businesses spend huge engineering costs managing servers on public clouds; hosting apps is tedious and error-prone
premises.evidence_span: businesses spend billions of dollars in engineering costs just to manage servers on AWS

premises.text: Render is a fully automated cloud that deploys from static sites to complex clusters without managing servers
premises.evidence_span: Render is a completely automated cloud provider

premises.text: Git push triggers automated build, deploy, patching, scaling, load balancing, and alerting
premises.evidence_span: Simply push your code to Git. We automate everything from there

premises.text: Built-in service discovery, private networking, and load balancing on every service
premises.evidence_span: every Render service gets built-in service discovery, private networking, and load balancing

premises.text: Fully managed SSDs with automatic backups and one-click restores
premises.evidence_span: Render is the first fully managed cloud to offer SSDs with automatic backups and one-click restores

premises.text: Infrastructure can be defined in one file and updated by pushing to Git
premises.evidence_span: You can define all your render services in just one file

premises.text: Priced far below stagnating managed clouds while offering AWS-like flexibility with Heroku-like ease
premises.evidence_span: Just two gigabytes of RAM costs $250 a month on Heroku compared to $25 a month on Render

value.text: Save engineering costs by automating cloud hosting without managing servers
value.evidence_span: looking to save big on engineering costs, automate your cloud hosting

notes: Three stage-launched innovations split as distinct product mechanisms (discovery/networking, SSD backups, IaC file). Git automation cascade kept as one deploy pipeline. Transcript appears cut mid-sentence at close. Revenue/traffic traction excluded.
